provenance.source: Original native Burt body/OBJ graphics with complete virtual native PPU views; original unmodified simulation world positions remain authoritative

main.source: Native Yoshi Europe Burt RGBA, isolated original PPU BG2 render plus native4bpp OBJ
main.fixture: Run1100 native intro/growth frames toinitialize PPU graphics, thenrestore each original WRAM/GSU/VRAM/OAM/CGRAM snapshot independently; transpose only private render actor tovirtualanchor, disable terrain/velocity; reapply original pose tables forsecondframe nativeOBJhardware latency. Original worldtrajectory/timing remain sourceWorldFeet and are never sourced from fixture movement.

planeIsolation.CGRAM0: GSU2000=7C1F controlled absent backdrop; strict guard against same value at any other native palette entry
planeIsolation.coverage: Native PPU body pixels retained wherever controlled backdrop is absent; Mesen unused framebuffer highbyte becomes nativecoverage alpha. Fullwidth entirelyblack forced-blank raster rows excluded, original bodypalette untouched. This is isolated native plane coverage, not original-scene color keying.

main.stitch: Tall native source yscale>=180h captured at192 and384. Upper band is registered by192px; native seam at16, without interpolation. Native pixels only; cropped bounds can have negativeY. Primary body exposure uses192 tofit native209-row viewport; taller stretches use384 upper exposure registered by192px, seam16.
main.nativeRaster: Source/render Mesen PAL239 raster has15 leading border lines and game209-row active region. Body plane shifts−15 to native OAM coordinates; lower viewport192 plus upper384 recover complete art.
